The '''Shintel system''' was located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], [[Shintel]], was home to a [[Imperial Depot 4290-1|military base]] established by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].
